description: This file defines the BadResponseException class, which is a specialized exception class used in GuzzleHttp to represent HTTP response errors (4xx or 5xx). It extends the RequestException class and includes methods to check for a response and retrieve it.

classes.name: BadResponseException
classes.description: An exception class representing HTTP error responses, extending RequestException, with methods to verify and access the response.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for BadResponseException, initializes the exception with message, request, response, previous exception, and handler context.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Returns true indicating that this exception always has an associated response.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the associated ResponseInterface object, narrowed from the parent class method.
